subject: Speaker Invitation: Colo Hacks
body:
Hi Siddharth Jain,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am reaching out from the organizing team of Colo Hacks. We have been following your work at ElevenLabs and are very impressed by your contributions to the field.

We would be honored to have you join us as a speaker/mentor for our upcoming event. Your expertise would be invaluable to our attendees.

Could you please let us know if you would be open to a brief conversation about this opportunity?

Best regards,

The Colo Hacks Team

person_data.name: Siddharth Jain
person_data.title: Co-Founder & CTO
person_data.bio: Siddharth is the co-founder and CTO of ElevenLabs, a leading innovation platform.
